dedupe_keys.name: a comprehensive geospatial database of nearly 100 000 reservoirs in china

description: The Nanjing Institute of Geography and Limnology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and collaborators publish the China Reservoir Database, CRD v1.1. It combines 97,435 reservoir locations with inundation area, estimated storage capacity, river order, discharge and residence time. A documented subset of 5,143 reservoirs adds names, normal water level, class, primary use and regulation type from yearbooks and other records. ScienceDB distributes Shapefile and CSV content under CC-BY-4.0; its public metadata identifies version 3, updated in March 2026. The original Zenodo page redirects users to this ScienceDB deposit and no longer lists files. The resource is free, but file retrieval was not tested. Inventory dates and measurement methods vary, and many capacities are estimates, not operator-certified values. Modellers could use it to build reservoir storage and exposure inventories for water-system simulations in China, with operating rules added separately. It complements data-geodar-georeferenced-global-dams-reservoirs with substantially denser national coverage, subject to harmonising identities and dates.
